name: Home page opens
expected: The page title contains IDBridge UG and the home page is visible.

name: Registered but no ID
expected: Selecting the missing-ID problem displays delayed-ID guidance.

name: Collection point guidance
expected: Selecting the collection problem displays safe collection instructions.

name: Verification failure
expected: Selecting verification displays provider and official-support guidance.

name: Rejected application
expected: Selecting rejection displays rejection-specific next steps.

name: Renewal guidance
expected: Selecting renewal displays renewal, replacement and correction guidance.

name: Empty form validation
expected: Submitting an empty form displays a clear validation message.

name: Unexpected input handling
expected: Unexpected text is handled safely without an error or unsafe rendering.

name: Language switching
expected: Switching to Luganda changes the primary heading to Luganda content.

name: Mobile layout
expected: At 375px viewport width, the page has no horizontal overflow.

name: Unauthorized guide editing denied
expected: An unauthorised user cannot edit or publish a guide.

name: Authorised update and audit log
expected: An authorised update is saved and an audit event is recorded.
